_about: Correspondence of commonly charged Indian Penal Code, 1860 sections to the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (in force 1 July 2024). Used to suggest the BNS counterpart when an FIR for an incident on or after 1 July 2024 cites the IPC. A review aid: confirm against the official correspondence table before charging. bns = null means the offence was not retained in the BNS.

sources.name: Ministry of Home Affairs / BPR&D, 'Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 - Comparison with IPC' (correspondence table)
The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), Gazette of India Extraordinary, Part II Section 1, 25 December 2023
